title: Resistors : Load banks - Torivac
text:
Resistors : Load banks

We have a product range from 50W to 200K W, standard or custom-made to customer specifications, including low inductance resistors, high voltage cut-off, high operating voltage, suitable for high energy pulses and designs for natural cooling or forced ventilation. Our resistors can be supplied from IP00 to IP54 and in special versions (with special insulation, non-inductive, special terminals or cables and thermal switch. 

Explore subcategories
Boxed
For applications such as variable speed and frequency drives, cranes, industrial automation, motor control, dynamic braking, renewable energies (such as wind and solar) and both loading and unloading, these boxed resistors consist of a tubular helical resistor. That is, it is a ceramic tube with a high degree of thermal dissipation and mechanical strength inside a galvanized sheet metal box IP20 and properly perforated for proper ventilation. This type of boxed resistors is manufactured according to the characteristics requested by the customer, customizing the boxed resistor with a cemented coiled tubular resistor or helical coiled tubular resistor; a high degree…

Braking resistors
Braking resistors are intended to dissipate the energy generated by a motor during deceleration, preventing damage to the drive due to overvoltage and ensuring that it stops safely. TORIVAC is a manufacturer of different types of dynamic braking resistors, which offer an economical and small size solution for braking control by absorbing and dissipating energy efficiently and effectively. A braking resistor helps to slow down or stop a motor by dissipating the excess voltage generated by the decelerating motor.
Learn more
Cemented
Our high power cemented resistors are manufactured from high quality resistive alloy wire. The ohmic value varies little with the temperature rise of the element. These are wound resistors composed of a resistive element wound on a ceramic tubular core used as a support and coated with a resin to ensure high dissipation capacity and excellent resistance to thermal shock and overload. It is a low inductance open element that allows very low ohmic values.
Learn more
Grounding resistors
Neutral grounding resistors are especially recommended for the protection of power transformers and generators in case of ground faults in medium and low voltage electrical distribution networks. Our custom-made grounding resistors, equipped with a current transformer, offer a high thermal capacity to absorb large currents. Our resistors can also integrate all types of accessories (switches, contactors, control elements, terminal boxes, etc.).
Learn more
Helical
Our high power model power resistors are manufactured with high quality resistive alloy wire. The ohmic value varies little with the temperature rise of the element. These are wound resistors composed of a resistive element wound on a ceramic tubular core used as a support, to ensure high dissipation capacity and excellent resistance to thermal shock and overload. It is an open element with low inductance.
Learn more
Load banks
As a manufacturer of resistive elements, we can supply resistive loads to load bank and dump bank manufacturers: Manufactured with different types of resistive elements depending on the applications and power requirements, we can provide load banks with high dissipation capacity and excellent resistance to thermal shocks and overloads, especially recommended for small power ratings (up to 30 kW) and for higher power ratings, loads that offer a low induction coefficient, and a high energy absorption capacity.
Learn more
Starting resistors
